confirmation_design.rule: rules 1 to 10, as in force since 4 November 2026 (GO #1393)
confirmation_design.operational_checks_read: data quality and the contract only; no early pass and no efficacy stopping
confirmation_design.score: the protocol's 23-quantile score averaged over h = 1 to 5, equal weight per decision origin; h = 1 reported beside it
confirmation_design.bootstrap: joint stationary block bootstrap of whole origin vectors
confirmation_design.claim_b: gated: tested only if A passes; descriptive otherwise

power_beside_the_design.kind: Pass rate of claim A at 500 origins, in percent, from #1392's full mode (500 simulated data sets per cell, development data, not a verdict). B1'* is the uncapped baseline and B2 stands in for B2*; the capped baselines are not in that study.

columns.b1_binding_10pct: true skill 10% against B1'*, B2 as developed (the claim as ruled)
columns.both_10pct: true skill 10% against both baselines (why the claim is against B1'*-cap alone)
columns.development_level: the development skill unscaled against both baselines as developed

power_beside_the_design.reading: Development data, not a verdict. 500 origins is short of 80% power at 10% skill (80% is first reached at 2,500 origins, 85.8% block and 87.0% regime); a confirmation that is inconclusive at 500 origins is reported as inconclusive with this power beside it, never as lack of skill. The rates come from a bootstrap with far fewer draws than 50,000 and from schemes that resample 2018 to 2026 origins.
